decisions.reason: Because this HVAC plate heat exchanger is close to the firm’s core heat-exchange know-how and the firm has strong in-house R&D and service-based learning, management would likely keep it despite only limited market evidence so far.

This marine box cooler system builds directly on established capabilities and already shows strong market acceptance through a reported major market share, so management would almost certainly keep it.

The marine cooling unit fits the firm’s existing marine and cooling knowledge base, and its dedicated web presence suggests commitment and enough related expertise to continue improving it rather than drop it.

The compact oil cooler is technically close to the firm’s established offer, and with its own R&D and broad engineering base the firm is more likely to refine and support it than withdraw it after a short time on the market.

Finned tubes for air coolers are strongly related to the firm’s existing exchanger portfolio, and the firm’s absorptive capacity and broad product strategy make continued commercialization more likely than exit.

Enhanced heat exchanger tubes are an adjacent product that the firm can readily understand and improve using its engineering, manufacturing, and R&D capabilities, so management would likely keep them on the market.
